text:
noah: RFC follow-up: we need a CLI-assisted migration path from org-keys -> project-scoped + exchange. Major ask: minimize customer breakage and provide automated suggestions. cc @sasha @emily

sasha: agree. propose a scan tool that finds org-key usage, groups by pattern (ci, cron, support), and suggests capability_set and the minimal migration (exchange vs service registration).

emily: scan should produce a patch PR with code hints and an option to add ExchangeClient helper. Provide dry-run first.

ben: for CI we should surface manifest-hash pinning recommendations. tool can compute manifest and provide a one-click register-service flow.

rashid: ops concern: the migration CLI must rate-limit calls to exchange and support a retryable backoff; also provide a preview of affected targets and a safety-mode that only outputs suggestions.

audit-bot: requirement: migration must tag suggested replacements with policy_id and create a ticket in audit system. logs must reference orig_key_id.

noah: CLI sketch:
```
redwood-auth-migrate --scan-repo . --output=pr --dry-run
# produces: migration_report.json and suggested PR with ExchangeClient usage
```

sasha: include a 'compat shim' that wraps old org-key with auto-exchange on behalf of legacy libs. Shim is opt-in and emits deprecation warnings.

emily: UX: console should show 'Migrate' button per key that runs CLI in a cloud-runner and opens PR in repo with suggested edits. Provide owner-approval links.

ben: security: ensure migration doesn't leak keys in PRs. Use placeholder tokens and require reviewer to run local exchange to verify. Add pre-submit check to remove any literal secrets.

rashid: implement a canary: run migration on internal repos, measure failures, and alert on unexpected policy rejections. Add circuit-breaker if >X failures/min.

noah: open questions: should CLI automatically register services when suggested? my vote: no, require owner approval for registration; CLI can create a registration request.

sasha: agree. require approval; CLI includes link to owner-approve and can poll status to continue.

emily: timeline: prototype 4w, internal canary 2w, public beta behind flag 6w, full deprecation 90d after beta. We'll include a rollback script to revert PRs and a reversible runtime toggle.

audit-bot: check: ensure all generated PRs include a 'why' note linking to RFC#142 and include risk ack checkbox. :white_check_mark:

rashid: I'll draft the ops readiness checklist and the rate-limit config. ben will make the shim and initial SDK helper. sasha will own CLI. noah will land RFC addendum and migration playbook.

emily: thanks, will start sketches and a demo repo. :rocket:
